title: Fix light-mode code styling on stdlib module pages
description: Code blocks on /stdlib/classify/ (and all stdlib module pages) use hardcoded dark background/text in stdlib-module.module.css, causing dark-on-dark in light mode. Use theme variables (--color-code-bg, --color-code) and make copy button and prompt theme-aware so code is readable in both light and dark mode.

title: Fix Amplify Build Pipeline
description: Diagnose and fix build errors in Amplify hosting pipeline for main branch
notes: Diagnosed build failure: Tailwind CSS v4 PostCSS plugin moved to separate package. Fixed by updating postcss.config.js to use @tailwindcss/postcss and adding to devDependencies.
